source: Public wind-sport spot guides, read in a browser

sources.what: Map markers of the Ireland kite spot list (89 spots).
Map markers on the six Irish regional pages (82 spots).
Map markers of the association's locations page (89 locations, of which operators, a hotel and a surf-only break were left out).
Map locations of the Ireland page; used only where another source or the evidence link shows wind sports.

note: Names, coordinates and sport tags transcribed from the map markers of public spot guides. No descriptions, photos or safety advice copied. The guides state no open licence, so these are factual references, not a relicensed catalogue. Where guides disagree about a position the first sport-backed listing supplies the coordinate and every listing is kept. Spots within about a kilometre of an existing riding place were merged into it rather than added.
